> Himanshu Khandelwal (also known as Design Daddy) is a web designer, web developer and cyber security professional. He designs and builds custom websites, scroll-animated websites and business automations for small businesses, agencies and founders. He placed 5th in the CompTIA national CTF.

Website: https://himanshukhandelwal.in/

## Services
- Custom website design and development: fast, mobile-friendly websites built to turn visitors into enquiries.
- Scroll-animated and interactive websites: memorable, motion-driven sites.
- Website and business automation: Telegram bots, alerts and lead capture.

## How he works
- Free 15-minute call first, then a design concept shown before anything is built.
- Fast delivery, refined with the client until they are happy.

## Frequently asked questions
### Who is Himanshu Khandelwal?
Himanshu Khandelwal, also known as Design Daddy, is a web designer, web developer and cyber security professional. He designs and builds custom websites and automations for agencies and small businesses, and placed 5th in the CompTIA national CTF.

### What website services do you offer?
I offer custom website design and development, scroll-animated and interactive websites, and business automation such as Telegram bots and lead capture. I build with security in mind.

### How much does a website cost?
It depends on the number of pages, the features and the level of animation. After a free 15-minute call I give you a clear quote before any work starts.

### Can you guarantee more sales or higher Google rankings?
No. No honest web designer can. A well-built website gives your business a stronger chance, but sales, leads and rankings also depend on your product, price, market, competition and marketing, which I do not control. I do not guarantee any increase in sales, traffic or search position, and reviews on this site are individual experiences.

### How long does it take to build a website?
Delivery is fast. I show you a design concept first, then build it and refine it with you. After the free call I give you a timeline for your specific project.

### Will I see the design before you build it?
Yes. I show a design concept first and revise it with you until you are happy with it. Only then do I build it.

### Do you build websites for small businesses and agencies?
Yes. My recent work includes a website for a social media marketing agency, a visa consultancy and a homes brand.

### Can you automate parts of my business?
Yes. For example, I built a Telegram bot that watches for US visa appointment slots and alerts an agency the moment one opens. I can build alerts, lead capture and custom tools around your process.

### Do you offer cyber security services?
I am a cyber security practitioner and capture-the-flag competitor, with a 5th rank in the CompTIA national CTF. That background shapes how I build: websites and tools that are secure by default. For a dedicated security project, tell me what you need on a free call.

### How do I get started?
Message me on WhatsApp or email to book the free 15-minute call. Tell me about your business and what you want your website to do, and I will tell you exactly what it needs to win more customers. I reply within 24 hours.
